findings.requirement: Heat treatment and hardness are specified where required, with the stage they apply at

evidence.quote: HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :- 1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 56~60 HRC. 2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm. 3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT. 4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )

findings.comment: The title block field 'heat_treatment' is set to '---', which conflicts with Note N2 that explicitly requires case hardening to 56~60 HRC. This ambiguity creates a risk that the heat treatment step could be overlooked during manufacturing. The designer should update the title block 'heat_treatment' field to specify 'Case Hardened' or reference Note N2.
findings.recommended_correction: Update the title block 'heat_treatment' field to match the requirements in Note N2 (e.g., 'Case Hardened').
